lines.en: label springtime18:
scene amiconsoles1
: Affection........decay..........ten points..........everyone........leaving.........
lines.zh: : 好感度……下降……十点……所有人……正在离开……

lines.en: : Not everyone! I’m still here! You’re okay!
lines.zh: : 不是所有人！我还在这儿！你没事的！

lines.en: : They didn’t hurt you, did they? {b}Let me see your hands.{/b} I want to make sure you didn’t get any glass stuck in them.
lines.zh: : 她们没伤到你吧？{b}让我看看你的手。{/b}我得确认你没有扎进玻璃碴。

lines.en: scene amiconsoles2
: I know! I’m sorry! I shouldn’t have left you! I thought they’d be at the party! I didn’t expect them to come here! Not today!
lines.zh: : 我知道！对不起！我不该丢下你的！我以为她们会在派对上！没想到她们会来这儿！偏偏是今天！

lines.en: scene amiconsoles3
: You’re right. It isn’t safe here anymore...
lines.zh: : 你说得对。这儿已经不安全了……

lines.en: : If those two are going to try stealing you away from me, it means others might try something as well.
lines.zh: : 如果那两个人打算把你从我身边偷走，那就意味着别人也可能会动手。

lines.en: : Ayane’s already here every day. And Niki and Noriko keep trying to get inside too. Which means it’s only a matter of time before Chika and Makoto and everyone else comes breaking in next.
lines.zh: : Ayane 已经天天都在这儿了。Niki 和 Noriko 也一直想进来。也就是说，Chika、Makoto 还有其他人闯进来只是时间问题。

lines.en: : It’s you and me against the world. {i}Again.{/i} But we’ve fought this fight before. We just need to hang on a little bit longer and we’ll have the life we’ve always wanted.
lines.zh: : 是你我对抗全世界。{i}又一次。{/i}不过这场仗我们以前打过。只要再撑一会儿，我们就能过上一直想要的生活。

lines.en: scene amiconsoles4
: Doesn’t that sound great?! It’ll be like the last two months, just it’ll go on forever and ever and ever and ever and ever-
lines.zh: : 听起来是不是很棒？！就会像过去这两个月一样，只不过会永远、永远、永远、永远、永远地持续下去——
: 她……在哪儿？……

lines.en: scene amiconsoles5
: I’m afraid I don’t know what you’re talking about, [amimaster]. And I imagine that, right now, you’re so shaken up from the house being broken into that {i}you{/i} don’t know either.
lines.zh: : 恐怕我不知道你在说什么，[amimaster]。而且我想，现在你被入室的事吓坏了，{i}你{/i}自己也不知道。

lines.en: : So why don’t you just lay back down while I clean up the glass and figure out how to replace a window?
lines.zh: : 所以你就躺好吧，我来收拾玻璃，再想想怎么换块窗户。
: 是我的错…………

lines.en: : She’s gone.......because of-
lines.zh: : 她走了……因为——

lines.en: scene amiconsoles6
: Stop blaming yourself for everything!
lines.zh: : 别再把一切都怪到自己头上了！

lines.en: : You always do that, but you’ve never done a {i}thing{/i} wrong in your life! You’re a good person! It’s everyone else who’s evil, not you!
lines.zh: : 你总是这样，可你这辈子从来没有做错过{i}一件事{/i}！你是个好人！邪恶的是其他所有人，不是你！

lines.en: : And if anyone {i}did{/i} leave, it’s probably because they realized they never deserved you in the first place! Or that they never loved you at all!
lines.zh: : 如果真的有人{i}离开{/i}了，那大概是因为她们终于意识到自己从来就配不上你！或者她们根本就没有爱过你！

lines.en: : All those girls! All those messages and dirty pictures! They were all trying to take advantage of you! Every single one of them! But they failed!
lines.zh: : 那些女孩！那些短信和色情照片！她们全都在想方设法占你便宜！每一个都是！可她们失败了！

lines.en: : They failed because you still chose me in the end! Like you’re supposed to! Because you know that I’m the only one for you! The only one who will ever get it!
lines.zh: : 她们失败，是因为你最后还是选择了我！就像你本该做的那样！因为你知道，我是唯一适合你的人！唯一一个永远都懂你的人！

lines.en: scene amiconsoles7
: I know...
lines.zh: : 我知道……

lines.en: : I tell myself I’m the perfect niece, but I know better than anyone how perfection’s just a lie now that Mom is gone.
lines.zh: : 我总告诉自己我是个完美的侄女，可我比谁都清楚，妈妈不在了之后，「完美」不过是个谎言。

lines.en: : I’m trying really hard to be just like her...but it seems impossible, [amimaster]. How could one half ever replace a whole?
lines.zh: : 我非常努力地想变得跟她一样……可这似乎是不可能的，[amimaster]。一半怎么可能替代一个整体呢？

lines.en: scene amiconsoles8
: What?...
: You {i}saw{/i} her?
lines.zh: : 你{i}见到{/i}她了？

lines.en: : Where?...How?...
lines.zh: : 在哪儿？……怎么会？……

lines.en: : In a dream?...Because, if that’s the case, I see her too. Every night when I close my eyes.
lines.zh: : 在梦里？……因为如果是这样，那我也见到她。每天晚上我一闭眼就见到。

lines.en: : Well, maybe not {i}every{/i} night because I always {i}always{/i} dream of you too. But when it’s not you, which it always is, it’s her.
lines.zh: : 嗯，也许不是{i}每一{/i}晚，因为我也总是、{i}总是{/i}梦到你。不过当梦里的不是你的时候——虽然一直都是你——那就是她。

lines.en: : Sometimes, it’s the three of us. Sometimes my dad is there too.
lines.zh: : 有时候是我们三个。有时候我爸爸也在。

lines.en: : But...you know what, Sensei? You’re just as much of a dad to me as he was. Maybe even more so.
lines.zh: : 不过……你知道吗，Sensei？你对我而言，和他一样是个父亲。也许甚至更甚。

lines.en: : You’ve been with me longer, after all. Not by much, but by enough. And you’ve seen me grow into a special girl who-
lines.zh: : 毕竟你陪我的时间更长。长不了多少，但也够了。而且你看着我长成了一个特别的女孩，一个——

lines.en: scene amiconsoles9
: Shut up!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴！

lines.en: scene amiconsoles10
: You’ve seen me grow into a special girl who would do anything to make you happy. {i}Anything.{/i} So if there’s anyone you want me to get rid of, all you have to do is tell me. [amimaster].
lines.zh: : 你看着我长成了一个特别的女孩，一个为了让你开心什么都愿意做的女孩。{i}任何事。{/i}所以如果你想让我除掉谁，只要跟我说一声就行。[amimaster]。

lines.en: : It’s either that, or we leave everyone behind and go somewhere no one can find us.
lines.zh: : 要么这样，要么我们抛下所有人，去一个没人找得到我们的地方。

lines.en: : Somewhere {i}outside{/i} the barrier.
lines.zh: : 一个在结界{i}外面{/i}的地方。

lines.en: : I’m sure it’ll be scary, but-
lines.zh: : 我知道那会很可怕，不过——

lines.en: : Why “no?” Don’t tell me you {i}want{/i} all those evil girls chasing after you all day? Because we both know that would be a lie.
lines.zh: : 为什么「不」？别告诉我你{i}想要{/i}那些坏女孩整天追着你跑？因为我们俩都知道那是谎话。

lines.en: : And right now, anything you {i}think{/i} you want is a thought you’re only thinking ‘cause you’re cornered.
lines.zh: : 而且现在，任何你{i}以为{/i}自己想要的东西，都只是因为被逼到墙角才产生的念头。

lines.en: scene amiconsoles11
: Close your eyes. Close your eyes and think back to the moment you were happiest.
lines.zh: : 闭上眼睛。闭上眼睛，回想你最幸福的那一刻。

lines.en: : What is it you see, [amimaster]?
lines.zh: : 你看到了什么，[amimaster]？

lines.en: scene 5
scene 4
scene 3
scene 2
scene 1
scene hanabi3
: {b}Don’t talk. You’ll just ruin everything.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}别说话。你只会把一切都毁了。{/b}

lines.en: : You see {i}me,{/i} don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你看到的是{i}我，{/i}对吧？

lines.en: : You’ve seen so many things, yet it’s {i}me{/i} who’s at the forefront of your happiest memory.
lines.zh: : 你见过那么多东西，可在你最幸福的记忆最前面的，是{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: : You probably see the two of us...cuddled together on the couch...your body pressing up against mine...
lines.zh: : 你大概看到我们两个……在沙发上依偎在一起……你的身体紧贴着我的……

lines.en: : You can feel my warmth...smell my shampoo...and I can hear your heartbeat.
lines.zh: : 你能感觉到我的体温……闻到我的洗发水味……而我听得到你的心跳。

lines.en: : Thump thump...thump thump...like it’s the soundtrack to a brighter day. And all my troubles melt a-
lines.zh: : 咚咚……咚咚……就像配着更明媚的一天的配乐。而我所有的烦恼都融化——

lines.en: scene amiconsoles12
: Don’t cry! Don’t cry! I’m right here! I’ve got you...
lines.zh: : 别哭！别哭！我就在这儿！我抱着你呢……

lines.en: : Is it...
lines.zh: : 是不是……

lines.en: : Is it really over?...
lines.zh: : 真的结束了吗？……

lines.en: : Is {i}what{/i} over? The...home intrusion? Yeah. Yeah, I sent them away before they could hurt you. You’re safe now.
lines.zh: : {i}什么{/i}结束了？那次……入室？是啊。是啊，我在她们伤到你之前把她们赶走了。你现在安全了。

lines.en: : No...that’s not...

lines.zh: : 是不是……

lines.en: : {b}Maya...{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}Maya……{/b}

lines.en: : Is she...
lines.zh: : 她是不是……

lines.en: scene amiconsoles13
: {i}Stop{/i} bringing her up.
lines.zh: : {i}别{/i}再提她了。

lines.en: : Maya never cared about you. And she never {i}will{/i} care about you because she’s a filthy liar who manipulates people into doing what she wants them to do. Plus, she-
lines.zh: : Maya 从来就没在乎过你。她也永远{i}不会{/i}在乎你，因为她是个肮脏的骗子，只会操纵别人去做她想让他们做的事。而且，她——

lines.en: scene amiconsoles14
: I told you to shut up!
lines.zh: : 我让你闭嘴！

lines.en: scene amiconsoles15
: Plus, she’s changed a lot these last couple months. I guess her true colors are really coming out now that her favorite {i}toy{/i} has been taken away.
lines.zh: : 而且，这两个月她变了很多。我想，她最心爱的{i}玩具{/i}被抢走之后，她的真面目终于露出来了。

lines.en: : I will be a toy if it means...
lines.zh: : 我愿意当个玩具，只要那意味着……

lines.en: scene amiconsoles16

: You will do nothing of the sort. Your brain is going haywire right now and you’re saying things you don’t mean. But that’s {i}my{/i} fault for leaving you alone in a place where people can find you.
lines.zh: : 你绝不会做那种事。你的脑子现在一团乱，说的都不是真心话。但那是{i}我{/i}的错，我不该把你一个人留在别人找得到的地方。

lines.en: : I should have worked harder to keep the bugs out.
lines.zh: : 我本该更努力地把窃听器都清干净的。

lines.en: : But I’ll learn from this mistake.
lines.zh: : 不过我会从这个错误里学到教训。

lines.en: : I’ll learn from this mistake and take you somewhere no one will be able to find you...so you can rest and recover in peace and remember just who it is you {i}really{/i} are.
lines.zh: : 我会从这个错误里学到教训，带你去一个没人找得到你的地方……好让你安静地休息、恢复，记起自己{i}真正{/i}是谁。

lines.en: : But until then...until you’re {i}you{/i} again...you’re just going to have to trust me.
lines.zh: : 但在那之前……在你重新变回{i}你{/i}之前……你只能相信我。

lines.en: : Only {i}I{/i} can fix you. Not Ayane. Not {i}Maya.{/i} And sure as hell not Uta and Io, who are probably blabbing to the rest of the girls as we speak.
lines.zh: : 只有{i}我{/i}能修好你。不是 Ayane。不是{i}Maya。{/i}当然更不是 Uta 和 Io，她们大概这会儿正在跟其他女孩乱说呢。

lines.en: : It was only a matter of time until the lot of them started forcing their way in, just like they forced themselves into your contacts and your life. Into {i}our{/i} life. A life I’ve wanted back for {i}years.{/i}
lines.zh: : 她们迟早会开始硬闯进来，就像她们硬是挤进你的通讯录、你的生活一样。挤进{i}我们的{/i}生活。一个我{i}盼了好多年{/i}才盼回来的生活。

lines.en: : I won’t give it up again, [amimaster]. The sting of loneliness is a bit too much for a frail little girl like me to bear.
lines.zh: : 我不会再放手了，[amimaster]。孤独的刺痛，对我这么一个脆弱的小女孩来说有点太难承受了。

lines.en: : And you don’t want to see me {i}break,{/i} do you?
lines.zh: : 你也不想看我{i}崩溃{/i}吧，对吗？

lines.en: : You want to keep me {i}happy,{/i} don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你想让我一直{i}开心，{/i}对吗？

lines.en: : Exactly.
lines.zh: : 就是嘛。

lines.en: : I didn’t...say anything...
lines.zh: : 我……什么都没说……

lines.en: scene amiconsoles17
: You don’t need to.
lines.zh: : 你不需要说。

lines.en: : I understand you better than {i}you{/i} ever will.
lines.zh: : 我比你{i}自己{/i}更懂你。

lines.en: : Now close your eyes and drink your milk while I read you another Christmas story.
lines.zh: : 现在闭上眼睛，把牛奶喝了，我再给你读一个圣诞故事。

lines.en: scene black
: When the morning comes, you’ll feel much better. Every day you grow some more.
lines.zh: : 等早上到了，你就会感觉好很多。每一天你都会长大一点。

lines.en: : A perfect season, perfect weather-
lines.zh: : 完美的季节，完美的天气——

lines.en: : On the way to twenty-four.
lines.zh: : 走在通往二十四的路上。

lines.en: scene 2
scene 4
scene amiconsoles18
Miles away, we’re reunited with a very peculiar family as they carefully inspect a building purchased by the eldest child.
lines.zh: 几英里之外，我们与一个非常古怪的家庭重逢，她们正在仔细检查一栋由长女买下的建筑。

lines.en: While she initially claimed the reason for this was to better prepare her for the future ahead, the truth is that it was a concerted effort to make an adult male like her more.
lines.zh: 虽然她一开始声称这么做是为了更好地为未来做准备，但真相是，这是一个处心积虑的举动，为了让一个成年男性更喜欢她。

lines.en: The thing is, this truth wasn’t even known by her at the time the property was purchased — and it wouldn’t become relevant until days later on a hidden beach inhabited by glowing insects.
lines.zh: 问题是，在购买这处房产的时候，连她自己都不知道这个真相——而它要到几天后，在一处住着发光昆虫的隐秘海滩上才会变得有意义。

lines.en: There, bathed in neon light, she would take inadvertent notice of the beating of her heart — thump thump, thump thump — as she subconsciously thanked God that she showed up when she did.
lines.zh: 在那里，沐浴在霓虹灯光下，她会不经意地留意到自己的心跳——咚咚，咚咚——同时在潜意识里感谢上帝，庆幸自己当时出现了。

lines.en: It was a selfish thought. And she hated having selfish feelings, so she shelved it the best she could and pretended to be apologetic about the interruption.
lines.zh: 那是个自私的念头。而她讨厌自己有自私的感觉，于是她尽力把它搁到一边，装作对那次打扰感到抱歉。

lines.en: But she was lying.
lines.zh: 可她在撒谎。

lines.en: She didn’t have much experience with lying, but she didn’t {i}need{/i} it as she had acquired the skill at birth.
lines.zh: 她撒谎的经验不多，但她{i}不需要{/i}经验，因为这项技能她生来就会。

lines.en: You see, her mother was exceptional at it. So exceptional that her daughters still believed her to be pure of heart despite the organ pumping sludge through her veins on a near constant basis.
lines.zh: 你要知道，她母亲在这方面出类拔萃。出色到她的女儿们至今仍相信她心地纯洁，尽管那颗器官几乎无时无刻不在往她血管里泵着污泥。

lines.en: It was this sludge that was passed on to her daughters. And while it had not fully corrupted them yet, it was sure to do so over time.
lines.zh: 传给女儿们的正是这种污泥。虽然它还没有彻底腐蚀她们，但随着时间的流逝必然会如此。

lines.en: Some might say it had already gotten to the youngest of the three — but those who {i}would{/i} say that have neglected her feelings just as much as her family has.
lines.zh: 有人会说，三姐妹中最小的那个已经被侵蚀了——但{i}会{/i}这么说的人，忽视她感受的程度和她家人不相上下。

lines.en: Another truth is that the young one was disposable. There was no need for a second child in the Tsukioka family. Their existence was naught more than a failsafe should the eldest perish.
lines.zh: 另一个真相是，那个小的是可有可无的。Tsukioka 家并不需要第二个孩子。她们的存在不过是长女万一出事时的一个保险。

lines.en: Tsukasa Tsukioka knew this. And some nights, she prayed that a terrible fate would befall her older sister because she knew it would make her more loved without needing to act out.
lines.zh: Tsukasa Tsukioka 知道这一点。有些夜晚，她会祈祷可怕的命运降临到姐姐身上，因为她知道那样自己不用刻意表现，也能得到更多爱。

lines.en: But she was also kind at heart, so these thoughts made her cry. And she would keep them to herself,  subconsciously unearthing them only during fits of anger or jealousy.
lines.zh: 可她本性善良，所以这些念头让她哭了出来。她会把它们藏在心里，只有在愤怒或嫉妒发作时才在潜意识里把它们挖出来。

lines.en: The three made an interesting trio. A solar system, if you will — with two small planets orbiting a sun that, if it wanted to, could destroy everything in its path.
lines.zh: 这三个人构成了有趣的三人组。可以说是一个太阳系——两颗小行星围绕着一颗太阳运转，而那颗太阳只要愿意，就能摧毁路径上的一切。

lines.en: But tonight was a night for creation. Or at least the {i}support{/i} of creation as one of the planets in the solar system was in the process of building its very own moon.
lines.zh: 但今晚是创造之夜。或者至少是{i}支持{/i}创造之夜，因为这个太阳系里的一颗行星正在建造属于它自己的月亮。

lines.en: Or perhaps it was a space station. Maybe even a satellite of sorts. Regardless, it was being put there not for aesthetic or tidal purposes, but for safety.
lines.zh: 也许那是座空间站。甚至可能是某种卫星。无论如何，把它放在那儿不是为了美观或潮汐，而是为了安全。

lines.en: It could be a meatless meat shield for unlucky asteroids — or shelter should humanity’s decline inch ever closer to zero.
lines.zh: 它可能是一面没有肉的肉盾，替不走运的小行星挡灾——又或是在人类的衰败一点点逼近归零时提供一个避难所。

lines.en: But whatever it was, it was dangerous since the kindness of one heart often incites nearby ones to latch on like cardiovascular lampreys.
lines.zh: 但不管那是什么，它都很危险，因为一颗心的善良常常会引得附近的心像心血管七鳃鳗一样吸附上来。

lines.en: These creatures would not know they were sucking sludge out of arterial straws.
lines.zh: 这些生物不会知道，自己正从动脉吸管里吸出污泥。

lines.en: And the world would turn black as the spread of this substance would no longer be avoidable.
lines.zh: 而当这种物质的扩散再也无法避免时，世界就会变黑。

lines.en: But I suppose that’s all conjecture.
lines.zh: 不过我想这些都只是猜测。

lines.en: I suppose that’s just one of many potential outcomes.
lines.zh: 我想这只是众多可能结局中的一种。

lines.en: After all, predicting the future means nothing when the past and the present so often rewrite themselves.
lines.zh: 毕竟，当过去和现在如此频繁地自我改写时，预测未来毫无意义。

lines.en: But it {i}does{/i} keep things interesting.
lines.zh: 但它{i}确实{/i}让事情变得有趣。

lines.en: And that was all the sun wanted at the end of the day.
lines.zh: 而那正是那颗太阳在一天结束时想要的全部。

lines.en: : Hmm...
Unless even {i}I’ve{/i} been lied to.
lines.zh: 除非连{i}我{/i}也被骗了。

lines.en: : Touka dear, you’ve contacted a contractor about the walls, correct? I’ve noticed cracks in several of them and I’m beginning to question just what was used to construct this building.
lines.zh: : Touka 亲爱的，你已经联系过承包商来看那些墙了吧？我注意到好几面墙上有裂缝，我开始怀疑这栋楼到底是用什么建的。

lines.en: : Yes, Mother. I have several quotes for repairs on file and three more inspections scheduled for tomorrow morning.
lines.zh: : 是的，母亲。我已经存档了好几份维修报价，明天上午还安排了三次检查。

lines.en: : Excellent. And Chika? Have you spoken with her recently?
lines.zh: : 很好。那 Chika 呢？你最近跟她说过话吗？

lines.en: : Not as recently as {i}you,{/i} I presume. I’ve been a bit preoccupied with {i}this.{/i}
lines.zh: : 大概没有{i}您{/i}那么最近吧。我一直在忙着{i}这个{/i}。

lines.en: : Yes, well, {i}she’s{/i} been a bit preoccupied with the apparent disappearance of your teacher. Which I assume is a contributing factor to your recent {i}attitude{/i} as well, my dear.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是这样，{i}她{/i}倒是有点在意你那位老师的离奇失踪。我想这也是你最近这副{i}态度{/i}的成因之一吧，亲爱的。

lines.en: : Mother, the television keeps breaking! I can’t get any channel to stay on!
lines.zh: : 母亲，电视一直在坏！我一个频道都停不住！

lines.en: : I wonder if it’s because it’s so small?
lines.zh: : 我在想，是不是因为它太小了？

lines.en: scene amiconsoles19
: Don’t worry, darling. I’m sure your sister has someone coming to look at {i}that{/i} tomorrow as well.
lines.zh: : 别担心，亲爱的。我相信你姐姐明天也会有人来看{i}那个{/i}的。

lines.en: : I do not have an {i}attitude,{/i} Mother. I am simply overwhelmed with the amount of work I’ve had to do as of late. And I would greatly appreciate it if you would not take {i}your{/i} attitude out on {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我没有{i}态度{/i}，母亲。我只是被最近要做的工作量压得喘不过气。如果您不要把{i}您{/i}的态度发泄到{i}我{/i}身上，我会非常感激。

lines.en: : I’m doing no such thing. I just don’t understand why you haven’t asked me to step in at all if the absence of your beloved teacher is causing you so much distress.
lines.zh: : 我可没有。我只是不明白，既然你那位亲爱的老师不在让你这么痛苦，你为什么完全没让我插手。

lines.en: scene amiconsoles20

: Aren’t we only meant to use our {i}influence{/i} when it means bettering something? Because, regardless of my personal feelings on the matter, Sensei’s absence does little measurable {i}harm{/i} to anyone.
lines.zh: : 我们不是只该在能让事情变好时才动用我们的{i}影响力{/i}吗？因为不管我个人对此有什么感受，Sensei 的缺席对任何人都没有什么可衡量的{i}伤害{/i}。

lines.en: : Yes, but don’t you think things have been awfully {i}boring{/i} these last two months? Even {i}I{/i} had more fun when he was around. Why, I’ve checked his room twice tonight in hopes of encountering him.
lines.zh: : 是吗，可你不觉得这两个月过得{i}无聊透顶{/i}吗？连{i}我{/i}在他身边的时候都更开心。就说今晚吧，我都去他房间查了两次，指望能碰上他。

lines.en: : Please stay out of my tenant’s rooms, Mother. It’s an invasion of their privacy and goes against several important terms in the rental agreement.
lines.zh: : 请您别进我租客的房间，母亲。那侵犯了她们的隐私，也违反了租赁协议里好几条重要条款。

lines.en: scene amiconsoles21
: Mother! The television’s back on!
lines.zh: : 母亲！电视又好了！

lines.en: : This show looks kind of weird, though.
lines.zh: : 不过这个节目看起来有点怪。

lines.en: : That’s very nice, Tsukasa. And Touka, need I remind you that you only have {i}one{/i} tenant at the moment? And I doubt Ak...{i}ahem...{/i}Arakawa-sensei would mind me going through his things.
lines.zh: : 那很好，Tsukasa。还有 Touka，需要我提醒你吗——你目前只有{i}一位{/i}租客？而且我怀疑 Ak……{i}咳……{/i}Arakawa 老师不会介意我翻他的东西。

lines.en: : It’s {i}about{/i} to be two. And Sensei doesn’t {i}have{/i} anything for you to go through, Mother. He barely even uses this place.
lines.zh: : {i}快{/i}要有两位了。而且 Sensei 根本{i}没有{/i}什么可以让您翻的，母亲。他几乎不怎么用这地方。

lines.en: : Oh my, it sounds as if you’ve done a fair bit of exploring in his room as well. Haven’t you, dear?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，听起来你也在他房间里探索了不少呢。对吧，亲爱的？

lines.en: scene amiconsoles22
: Only when necessary.
lines.zh: : 只在必要的时候。

lines.en: : So you concede that we can get our hands dirty when it’s {i}necessary,{/i} do you? In that case, how much longer do you think we should wait before doing a little...{i}interference{/i} in his affairs?
lines.zh: : 所以你承认，在{i}必要{/i}的时候我们也可以弄脏手了，是吗？既然如此，你觉得我们还要等多久，才对他的事做一点……{i}干涉{/i}？

lines.en: : For the greater good, of course. That greater good being {i}us.{/i}
lines.zh: : 当然是为了更大的善。而那个更大的善就是{i}我们{/i}。

lines.en: : Don’t you mean {i}me?{/i} He’s my teacher, after all. And unless you don’t trust me, you have little reason to even communicate with him.
lines.zh: : 你是指{i}我{/i}吧？他毕竟是我的老师。而且除非你不信任我，否则你根本没什么理由要跟他打交道。

lines.en: : Well, that’s not true at all. He’s become quite a good friend of mine. And soon, he’ll be tutoring your little sister. Isn’t that right, Tsukasa?
lines.zh: : 嗯，这可完全不对。他已经成了我相当要好的朋友。而且很快，他就要给你妹妹当家教了。对吧，Tsukasa？

lines.en: scene amiconsoles23
: Yes, Mother. And, is it okay if I stand next to you now? This show is really weird.
lines.zh: : 是的，母亲。还有，我现在可以站到您旁边吗？这个节目真的很怪。

lines.en: : Of course, dear. And you don’t need permission to stand next to me.
lines.zh: : 当然可以，亲爱的。而且你站到我旁边不需要经过允许。

lines.en: : Could you not find her a different tutor? It’s one thing to delay her studies for two months, but to do so because you’re waiting for {i}my{/i} teacher to become available is just...well, it’s odd.
lines.zh: : 您就不能给她找别的家教吗？把她的学业推迟两个月是一回事，可为了等{i}我{/i}的老师有空才这么做，就……嗯，太奇怪了。

lines.en: : Nonsense, dear. Tsukasa’s taken quite the liking to Arakawa-sensei. Haven’t you, Tsukasa?
lines.zh: : 胡说，亲爱的。Tsukasa 可喜欢 Arakawa 老师了。对吧，Tsukasa？

lines.en: scene amiconsoles24
: That’s right, Mother. He {i}is{/i} my future husband after all. I will most likely {i}have{/i} to like him at some point.
lines.zh: : 没错，母亲。他{i}毕竟{/i}是我未来的丈夫。我多半在某个时候{i}必须{/i}喜欢上他。

lines.en: : Hahah! My, how adorable!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！哎呀，真是可爱！

lines.en: : Is there anything else the two of you need? Or can I go back to finalizing the listings for my apartment now?
lines.zh: : 你们俩还需要别的什么吗？还是说我可以回去把公寓的招租信息敲定了？

lines.en: : I advised Chika the room would be ready for her come the new year. And I’m beginning to worry it might take at least another three months to get you two {i}out{/i} of it.
lines.zh: : 我跟 Chika 说过，房间会在新年前为她准备好。而我开始担心，要把你们两个{i}请{/i}出去，恐怕至少还得再花三个月。

lines.en: scene amiconsoles25
: My, you’re awfully catty tonight, aren’t you? Who’d have known that my darling daughter’s first rebellious phase would be due to {i}love?{/i}
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你今晚可真尖牙利嘴，不是吗？谁能想到我亲爱的女儿第一次叛逆期竟然是因为{i}爱情{/i}？

lines.en: scene black
: Out! Now!
lines.zh: : 出去！现在！

lines.en: : Hahah! Come, Tsukasa. Let’s get you to bed.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈！来吧，Tsukasa。我们送你上床睡觉。

lines.en: : But...Mother! Touka just raised her voice at you! We’re never supposed to do that!
lines.zh: : 可是……母亲！Touka 刚刚对您提高嗓门了！我们从来都不可以这样！

lines.en: : Your big sister is going through a {i}very{/i} stressful time in her life right now, dear. It’s probably best if we keep our noses out of it until she’s feeling a little better.
lines.zh: : 你姐姐正在经历人生中一段{i}非常{/i}艰难的时期，亲爱的。在她心情好一点之前，我们最好还是别插手。

lines.en: : But that could take forever! What if she stays miserable for the rest of her life like all of my servants?
lines.zh: : 可那可能要等上一辈子！要是她像我那些仆人一样，余生都一直痛苦下去怎么办？

lines.en: : I’m sure she’ll go right back to normal once her teacher’s {i}vacation{/i} comes to an end.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，等她老师的{i}假期{/i}一结束，她就会立刻恢复正常。

lines.en: : I said get out!
lines.zh: : 我说了，出去！
